GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.112 (14 Dec 45) GS
(SCAPIN-523)
31 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Archives and Property in Canada.
The Japanese Government will promptly deliver to this Headquarters a request addressed to the Swiss Government instructing its representatives in Canada to deliver to the American Ambassador in Canada as representative of the Allied Powers all Japanese archives and property in that country. The Canadian Foreign Office does not plan to take custody.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
